capabilities: Create notes from a chosen type with only that type's fields
Constrain field values to catalogs with stable IDs and aliases
Search note titles and aliases in link fields
Edit and retype existing notes' properties
Check configuration files and vault notes for mismatches
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide cleanup or repair tool; it creates and edits individual notes from your own type definitions.
extras: Desktop only; distributed through BRAT until it is listed in the community directory. Ships a starter config with 21 example types and 6 catalogs, plus three example setups. No network access, account or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's Properties allow anything, which is great for freedom and bad for a collection
motivation: It started as the tool for a personal knowledge base of topics, concepts, people, places, works and events collected over years, with sources and links between disciplines.
problem: Obsidian's Properties accept any value, so over years property names, values and links drift and notes of the same kind can no longer be filtered reliably.

relations.evidence: With Obsidian's Bases you get reliable answers to "what haven't I finished?"
{{title}}, {{date}}, {{time}} and {{date:FORMAT}} work as in Obsidian's core Templates plugin

summary: Schema-driven note creator and editor that builds notes from JSON type definitions and catalogs, with typed fields, controlled values and a status bar.
